title: Satisfaction After Solving for a Pivot
statement: Let $\\nu$ be a finite set of variables, let an equation over $\\mathbb F_2$ have coefficients $a_v$ and constant $c$, and let $x:\\nu\\to\\mathbb F_2$ be an assignment. If the coefficient of a chosen pivot variable $p$ is $1$, replace $x(p)$ by $c+\\sum_{v\\ne p}a_vx(v)$, leaving the other values unchanged. The resulting assignment satisfies the equation.
